questions.question_text: This is a list of 8 numbers: 11, 7, 8, 13, 7, 14, 15, 5. Find the median.
An extra number is added to the list. The mean of the nine numbers is 1 more than the mean of the eight numbers. Find the ninth number.
Show this inequality on the number line: -3 < x <= 4
Express 175 as the product of its prime factors.
Kurt has two timers. One is set to ring every 175 minutes. The other is set to ring every 70 minutes. Both timers ring together at 09 15. Find the time when the timers next ring together.
Find the exterior angle of a regular polygon with 15 sides.

Eggs are graded into four sizes: extra large, large, medium and small. A farmer records the sizes of a sample of 100 eggs that she collects. The results are shown in the table. Size: Extra large (28), Large (36), Medium (24), Small (12). Find the relative frequency for large eggs.
In one month, the farmer collects 2500 eggs. Calculate an estimate for the number of these eggs that are small.
ABCD is a parallelogram. EDA and EFB are straight lines. Show that triangles EDF and BCF are similar.
BC = 4 cm, DE = 5 cm and FB = 3 cm. Find EF.
A is the point (-5, 7) and C is the point (1, -2). B is the mid-point of AC. Find the coordinates of B.
The line CD is perpendicular to the line AC. Find the equation of line CD.
y is inversely proportional to (x + 2)^2. When x = 3, y = 2. Find y in terms of x.
Find the positive value of x when y = 0.5.
a = (4, -10)^T, b = (-4, 2)^T. Find the magnitude of the vector a - b. Give your answer in its simplest surd form.
